sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection II, 
which must be performed for steam valves every six months as indicated by M6 
in above title block

A combined stop and control valve are provided in 
the main steam line supplying the HP steam turbine inlet

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abo El-Fetouh 
Shata, tested by eng. Ali A. Elslam and revised by MDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood and approved 
by eng Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha power station.

This document accepted by eng. Samer Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality 
control general director and superviser of inspection & quality control head 
sector

A 
 work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

السلامة 
 مطلوب سياج مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل
Shutdown the unit and be out of service
Isolate compressed air for all valve
Switch off gland exhaust and oil vapor extractor

Drain 
 the pipeline switch connected to this valves
